versions.changelog: v1.0.0: data export and cross-border compliance playbook for medical device companies - China 3+2+4 regulatory system and three pathways (security assessment, standard contract, export certification effective 2026-01-01), 100k/1M volume thresholds with cumulative counting, special requirements for medical/health data (first mandatory national standard, security review, GBA standard contracts), destination-market data laws (EU GDPR+EHDS 2025-03, US HIPAA 2026 upgrade, Singapore PDPA, Japan/Korea), export scenario playbooks (clinical data/CRO/cloud/telehealth/employee data), 5-step compliance and audit (Risk Assessment Measures 2026-08-20, 2026 assessment expiry window); 5-command zero-dependency toolkit
